description: This file contains the implementation of the EmployeeCheckin class and related functions for managing employee check-in logs, including validation, shift fetching, log addition, attendance linking, and working hours calculation within an HR management system.

classes.name: EmployeeCheckin
classes.description: Represents an employee check-in record with validation and shift fetching logic.

methods.name: add_log_based_on_employee_field
methods.description: Creates an Employee Checkin record based on employee field value and timestamp.

methods.name: mark_attendance_and_link_log
methods.description: Creates and links attendance records to check-in logs, handling different attendance statuses.

methods.name: calculate_working_hours
methods.description: Calculates total working hours from a set of check-in logs based on specified check-in/out type and calculation method.

methods.name: time_diff_in_hours
methods.description: Calculates the difference in hours between two datetime objects.

methods.name: find_index_in_dict
methods.description: Finds the index of a dictionary in a list where a specific key matches a given value.
